title: GPU capacity docket — morning scratch
content:
AM: quick pulse before standup
- observed: two racks (r5-r6) showing 6% higher preempt rate last 24h; spike aligns with batch job window (~02:30-04:00 UTC).
- tail latency on gpt-small-pool up ~30ms this morning vs baseline; investigate cache hit rate.

Checklist (ordered)
1) Run lightweight KV cache audit (5–10m)
   - grep logs: /var/log/kvcache/* for eviction events
   - cli: ./tools/kv-audit --pool=gpt-small --since=24h
2) Confirm no noisy tenants in dedicated pools (10m)
   - quick query: SELECT tenant, qps FROM capacity_metrics WHERE pool='dedicated-1' ORDER BY qps DESC LIMIT 8
3) Rebalance suggestion for r5 -> move 1 slot from r5 to r8 (15m)
4) Post short note to #infra-notify if we schedule drain (2m)

Quick commands to run (copyable)
- ssh ops@r5-node-02 'journalctl -u inference.service --since "24 hours ago" | tail -n 200'
- ./bin/pool-inspector --pool gpt-small --metric kv_hit_rate --window 24h --output csv > /tmp/gpt-small-kv.csv

Immediate hypotheses
- increased preempt rate caused by preemptible spot churn in eu-west-1 (check cloud provider events).
- a background rebuild job on r5 triggered network saturation that bumped latency for small sequences.
- kv cache eviction threshold too low for median seq length (rerun profile).

Notes to self / follow-ups
- Ping @Jordan (Slack) about recent PR that changed batching heuristics (PR#4521). Ask whether defaults were flipped for preferred_batch_size.
- Ask Kai to run a quick check on rack-level NIC errors (he mentioned he had queued a firmware bump).
- If we drain r5, coordinate with SRE for maintenance window 04:30–05:30 UTC; set canary to 2% traffic to r8 during move.

Mini plan (if issue persists after quick fixes)
- step A (triage): snapshot metrics + store in /home/epark/incident-snapshots/2026-03-13/ (command snippets above).
- step B (mitigate): temporarily reduce preemptible allocation on eu-west-1 pools by 20% and unlock reserved slots for critical customers.
- step C (root-cause): schedule a 1h deep-dive with profiling enabled (trace-level on serving runtime) and collect kernel selection logs.

Open questions (unsorted)
- Are there any new scheduled batch windows from data team? (check #solutions-data backlog)
- Did we roll a new kernel selection policy yesterday? (last deploy: 2026-03-12 23:45 by deploy-bot)

Little reminders (personal)
- remember to file the quick postmortem skeleton even if we fix quickly: 5 bullets + tl;dr + steps taken.
- update the slot-rebalance runbook with the recent r5->r8 command sequence (small doc).

Scratch ideas (brain dump)
- Add a transient telemetry tag "preempt_window" to requests that hit preemptible hosts so we can correlate user-latency with reclaim events without long-term tagging cost.
- Explore adaptive eviction threshold: raise kv cap for pools with >75th percentile short sequence ratio.

End-of-morning priorities (today)
- 09:15 run audit & post quick note in #infra-notify (blocking: none).
- 09:45 if noisy tenant present, open INFRA-1876 with initial findings and tentative mitigation.
- 11:00 sync with Jordan/Kai for decision on drains and firmware window.

Random scratch (todo items for later)
- finish notes for Dedicated capacity pricing experiment (10m)
- schedule fellow runbook review next Tue

--
Short, messy, actionable. Will clean and move to Confluence if we escalate.
